bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
git rev-parse HEAD
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/realdebug_030c71fab13b4726b5222b3f523b2900",timeout=10))
print("BENCHMARK",json.dumps({k:s.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","active_in_process","interrupted","error_code","started_at","current","summary","results")},ensure_ascii=False))
rid=(s.get("current") or {}).get("run_id")
if rid:
 d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/status/"+rid,timeout=10))["durable"]
 print("RUN",json.dumps({k:d.get(k) for k in ("job_status","active_in_process","workflow_cursor","last_execution_error","last_execution_failure","role_invocations")},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
